surface: List, Grid, getScrollbarSize, useDynamicRowHeight, four imperative-ref hooks, and all eight public types from react-window 2.3.1. The complete 119-case upstream unit suite runs in pristine React and generated Octane lanes, with differential, SSR, hydration, shared public types, and native Chromium startup, scrolling, and direction-change coverage.
divergences: Octane reserves the second raw function-component invocation argument for its internal block ABI; public props and rendered behavior match, so instrumentation should not assert React's undocumented undefined second argument.

Keyed state and DOM identity are preserved, but sibling effect-log order and equal-prop rerender counts may differ after reordering because Octane schedules moved blocks and memoizes unchanged children differently.
ssr: Supported and tested — defaultHeight/defaultWidth produce deterministic bounded List and Grid markup without browser globals, and hydration adopts the server nodes before live scrolling and measurement.
notes: Targets react-window v2.3.1. Legacy v1 FixedSizeList, VariableSizeList, FixedSizeGrid, and VariableSizeGrid APIs are absent from the pinned upstream package.

All 125 upstream registrations are accounted for: 119 paired unit cases, four native browser conformance cases, and two inapplicable React Server Components scenarios. Browser validation covers Chromium.
